examples.description: Create a video project (the composition document starts empty)

description: Create a video studio project — the composition document (scenes, tracks, clips, captions) starts empty and is built up afterward through the studio.* director tools. thumbnail_key is server-owned: send thumbnail_data_url instead, and this door externalizes it into a content-addressed R2 key through the media hygiene kit (magic bytes decide the type; SVG refuses). Free. NEXT: studio_project_read to verify.

thumbnail_data_url.description: Data URL (data:image/...) of the project thumbnail — the door externalizes it into a content-addressed R2 key through the media hygiene kit (magic bytes decide the type; SVG refuses). Never send thumbnail_key directly; it is server-owned and computed from this field. Omit to leave the thumbnail unset/unchanged.
